name: 1529-charset-charset-after-the-first-kind
models:
# The core module: what every track or point report means, in fixed units.
# Keys of this module are written bare in a pack (`lat`); keys of every other
# module are written `<module>.<key>`. spec/shared-model.md.
module        core
version       0.3.0
distribution  public
source        "goat-transformers spec/shared-model.md; type and how tokens follow the public Cursor on Target event schema"
key  uid       string  -      "stable identifier of the entity"
key  type      string  -      "CoT type token (a-f-G-U-C-I), the shared type vocabulary"
key  time_ms   int     ms     "time the report is valid, epoch milliseconds UTC"
key  time_ns   int     ns     "time the report is valid, epoch nanoseconds UTC"
key  time_error_ms  float  ms  "coherence error bound of the clock that stamped time_ms, >= 0: the bound, not the offset; absent when not stated"
key  time_state     string  -  "state of the clock that stamped time_ms: coherent, drifting or free-running; absent when not stated"
key  lat       float   deg    "latitude, WGS84"
key  lon       float   deg    "longitude, WGS84"
key  hae       float   m      "height above the WGS84 ellipsoid"
key  ce        float   m      "circular (horizontal) error"
key  le        float   m      "linear (vertical) error"
key  callsign  string  -      "human-readable name"
key  course    float   deg    "direction of travel, degrees true"
key  speed_ms  float   m/s    "ground speed"
key  how       string  -      "provenance token (m-g, h-e, ...)"
key  stale_ms  int     ms     "time after which the report is no longer valid, epoch milliseconds UTC"
key  time_text   string  -    "time_ms as the sender wrote it, unparsed, for a consumer that needs the text"
key  stale_text  string  -    "stale_ms as the sender wrote it, unparsed"
key  access    string  -      "the handling value the sender gives the report (CoT event/@access); passed through as text, never chosen by a conversion"
key  display_name  string  -  "the name the sender shows for the entity where it differs from callsign (CoT detail/uid/@Droid)"

# spec 0.31: time_ns and time_ms state the same instant; time_ms is floor(time_ns / 1000000)
derive  time_ns  ns_of_ms  time_ms
derive  time_ms  ms_of_ns  time_ns
# The probe module: synthetic keys for the conformance vectors of derived keys
# (engine-spec 0.6), of groups (engine-spec 0.7) and of sequential layouts
# (engine-spec 0.8). No format of the real world maps them; the packs
# `conformance-derive`, `conformance-rulings-*`, `conformance-groups-*` and
# `conformance-seq-*` do. One `derive` line per function that `track` does
# not use, a pair of lines that needs two passes, and a chain that needs nine.
module        probe
version       0.1.0
distribution  public
source        "goat-transformers spec/engine-spec.md (synthetic keys for conformance vectors, no external standard)"
key  a        float   -  "an input number"
key  neg_a    float   -  "derived: -a"
key  scaled   float   -  "derived: a * 2.5"
key  third    float   -  "derived: a * 1 / 3"
key  shifted  float   -  "derived: a - 0.5"
key  n        int     -  "an input integer"
key  n_next   int     -  "derived: n + 1000, integer addition"
key  n_copy   int     -  "derived: n"
key  s1       string  -  "an input text"
key  s2       string  -  "an input text"
key  joined   string  -  "derived: uid, s1 and s2 joined by /"
key  chain    float   -  "derived from `late`, which a later line derives: set in the second pass"
key  late     float   -  "derived: -a"
key  k0       int     -  "start of a chain of copies"
key  k1       int     -  "derived: k0"
key  k2       int     -  "derived: k1"
key  k3       int     -  "derived: k2"
key  k4       int     -  "derived: k3"
key  k5       int     -  "derived: k4"
key  k6       int     -  "derived: k5"
key  k7       int     -  "derived: k6"
key  k8       int     -  "derived: k7"
key  k9       int     -  "derived: k8; the ninth pass would set it, and there are eight"
key  j1       string  -  "derived: s1 joined with nothing else (a `join` of one argument)"
# Lists (engine-spec 0.7) and the keys their items hold.
key  label    string  -  "an item text"
key  qty      int     -  "an item integer"
key  ratio    float   -  "an item number"
key  tag      string  -  "a text of a nested item or of a scalar item"
key  val      int     -  "an integer of a nested item or of a scalar item"
list items    "items that hold label, qty, ratio and the nested list subs"
list subs     "nested in an item of items: items that hold tag and val"
list nums     "scalar items: each holds val"
list names    "scalar items: each holds tag"
list ratios   "scalar items: each holds ratio"
list deltas   "scalar items: each holds val (signed)"
list gains    "scalar items: each holds ratio (single precision)"
# Keys and a list of the sequential probe packs (engine-spec 0.8).
key  x        int     -  "an integer of a sequential probe pack"
key  y        int     -  "an integer of a sequential probe pack"
key  z        int     -  "an integer of a sequential probe pack"
key  w        int     -  "an integer of a sequential probe pack"
key  c1       int     -  "an integer in the first part of a chain"
key  c2       int     -  "an integer in the second part of a chain"
list recs     "items that hold x, y and label; in conformance-seq-kinds each item selects a kind"
# Targets of the derive functions added in engine-spec 0.8.
key  ds       float   s  "derived: seconds since UTC midnight of time_ms"
key  any1     int     -  "derived: 1 when any of x, y, z that is present is not 0"
key  notx     int     -  "derived: 1 when x is 0, else 0"
key  parsed   int     -  "derived: the decimal integer s1 holds"
key  text     string  -  "derived: n as decimal text"
# Keys of the value-transform probe packs (engine-spec 0.15).
key  big     int     -  "an integer a text wire carries with its exact decimal digits (iscale)"
key  thirds  int     -  "an integer the wire states in thirds of a unit (iscale:3:1)"
key  cnt     int     -  "an integer that a scaled text number holds, with an absent sentinel"
derive  probe.j1       join:-       probe.s1
derive  probe.ds       day_seconds  time_ms
derive  probe.any1     any          probe.x  probe.y  probe.z
derive  probe.notx     not          probe.x
derive  probe.parsed   parse_int    probe.s1
derive  probe.text     text_of      probe.n
derive  probe.neg_a    neg          probe.a
derive  probe.scaled   scale:2.5    probe.a
derive  probe.third    scale:1/3    probe.a
derive  probe.shifted  offset:-0.5  probe.a
derive  probe.n_next   offset:1000  probe.n
derive  probe.n_copy   copy         probe.n
derive  probe.joined   join:/       uid  probe.s1  probe.s2
derive  probe.chain    neg          probe.late
derive  probe.late     neg          probe.a
# each line needs the key the line below it sets: one more key per pass
derive  probe.k9  copy  probe.k8
derive  probe.k8  copy  probe.k7
derive  probe.k7  copy  probe.k6
derive  probe.k6  copy  probe.k5
derive  probe.k5  copy  probe.k4
derive  probe.k4  copy  probe.k3
derive  probe.k3  copy  probe.k2
derive  probe.k2  copy  probe.k1
derive  probe.k1  copy  probe.k0

# Arguments and targets of `present` (engine-spec 0.12), used by the pack
# conformance-present.
key  pr_s     string  -  "input of present: a text"
key  pr_f     float   -  "input of present: a number"
key  pr_i     int     -  "input of present: an integer"
key  pr_t     string  -  "input of present: a text whose wire value NA means absent"
key  pr_d     int     -  "input of present: an integer the pack gives a default"
key  has_s    int     -  "derived: 1 when pr_s is present"
key  has_f    int     -  "derived: 1 when pr_f is present"
key  has_i    int     -  "derived: 1 when pr_i is present"
key  has_t    int     -  "derived: 1 when pr_t is present"
key  has_d    int     -  "derived: 1 when pr_d is present"
key  pr_b     int     -  "input of present: a json boolean read as 1 or 0"
key  pr_c     int     -  "derived: a copy of pr_i, set by a derive line after the present line that reads it"
key  has_b    int     -  "derived: 1 when pr_b is present"
key  has_c    int     -  "derived: 1 when pr_c is present"
derive  probe.has_s  present  probe.pr_s
derive  probe.has_f  present  probe.pr_f
derive  probe.has_i  present  probe.pr_i
derive  probe.has_t  present  probe.pr_t
derive  probe.has_d  present  probe.pr_d
derive  probe.has_b  present  probe.pr_b
derive  probe.has_c  present  probe.pr_c
derive  probe.pr_c   copy     probe.pr_i
# Keys and `derive` lines of the derive functions added in engine-spec 0.16.
# Every argument here is a key no other probe pack maps, so these lines set
# nothing in the vectors of earlier versions.
key  t_ms       int    ms   "an input instant: milliseconds (sec_of, nsec_of)"
key  t_sec      int    s    "derived: sec_of t_ms"
key  t_nsec     int    ns   "derived: nsec_of t_ms"
key  u_sec      int    s    "an input instant: whole seconds (ms_of)"
key  u_nsec     int    ns   "an input instant: nanoseconds (ms_of)"
key  u_ms       int    ms   "derived: ms_of u_sec u_nsec"
key  ang_r      float  rad  "an input angle in radians (deg)"
key  ang_r_deg  float  deg  "derived: deg ang_r"
key  ang_d      float  deg  "an input angle in degrees (rad)"
key  ang_d_rad  float  rad  "derived: rad ang_d"
key  i0         int    -    "an input integer (add, sub)"
key  i1         int    -    "an input integer (add, sub)"
key  isum       int    -    "derived: add i0 i1, integer addition"
key  idiff      int    -    "derived: sub i0 i1, integer subtraction"
key  f0         float  m    "an input number (add, sub): a height above the ellipsoid"
key  f1         float  m    "an input number (add, sub): a geoid separation"
key  fsum       float  m    "derived: add f0 f1"
key  fdiff      float  m    "derived: sub f0 f1, a height above mean sea level"
key  dist       float  m    "an input distance (deg_lat_of, deg_lon_of)"
key  at_lat     float  deg  "an input latitude of the distance functions"
key  dist_dlat  float  deg  "derived: deg_lat_of dist at_lat"
key  dist_dlon  float  deg  "derived: deg_lon_of dist at_lat"
key  arc        float  deg  "an input angle (m_lat_of, m_lon_of)"
key  arc_mlat   float  m    "derived: m_lat_of arc at_lat"
key  arc_mlon   float  m    "derived: m_lon_of arc at_lat"
key  back_mlat  float  m    "derived: m_lat_of dist_dlat at_lat, dist again"
key  back_mlon  float  m    "derived: m_lon_of dist_dlon at_lat, dist again"
key  g_lat      float  deg  "an input geodetic latitude (ecef_x, ecef_y, ecef_z)"
key  g_lon      float  deg  "an input geodetic longitude"
key  g_hae      float  m    "an input height above the ellipsoid"
key  g_x        float  m    "derived: ecef_x g_lat g_lon g_hae"
key  g_y        float  m    "derived: ecef_y g_lat g_lon g_hae"
key  g_z        float  m    "derived: ecef_z g_lat g_lon g_hae"
key  g_rlat     float  deg  "derived: lat_of_ecef g_x g_y g_z, g_lat again"
key  g_rlon     float  deg  "derived: lon_of_ecef g_x g_y g_z, g_lon again"
key  g_rhae     float  m    "derived: hae_of_ecef g_x g_y g_z, g_hae again"
key  e_x        float  m    "an input ECEF x"
key  e_y        float  m    "an input ECEF y"
key  e_z        float  m    "an input ECEF z"
key  e_lat      float  deg  "derived: lat_of_ecef e_x e_y e_z"
key  e_lon      float  deg  "derived: lon_of_ecef e_x e_y e_z"
key  e_hae      float  m    "derived: hae_of_ecef e_x e_y e_z"
derive  probe.t_sec      sec_of       probe.t_ms
derive  probe.t_nsec     nsec_of      probe.t_ms
derive  probe.u_ms       ms_of        probe.u_sec  probe.u_nsec
derive  probe.ang_r_deg  deg          probe.ang_r
derive  probe.ang_d_rad  rad          probe.ang_d
derive  probe.isum       add          probe.i0  probe.i1
derive  probe.idiff      sub          probe.i0  probe.i1
derive  probe.fsum       add          probe.f0  probe.f1
derive  probe.fdiff      sub          probe.f0  probe.f1
derive  probe.dist_dlat  deg_lat_of   probe.dist  probe.at_lat
derive  probe.dist_dlon  deg_lon_of   probe.dist  probe.at_lat
derive  probe.arc_mlat   m_lat_of     probe.arc  probe.at_lat
derive  probe.arc_mlon   m_lon_of     probe.arc  probe.at_lat
derive  probe.back_mlat  m_lat_of     probe.dist_dlat  probe.at_lat
derive  probe.back_mlon  m_lon_of     probe.dist_dlon  probe.at_lat
derive  probe.g_x        ecef_x       probe.g_lat  probe.g_lon  probe.g_hae
derive  probe.g_y        ecef_y       probe.g_lat  probe.g_lon  probe.g_hae
derive  probe.g_z        ecef_z       probe.g_lat  probe.g_lon  probe.g_hae
derive  probe.g_rlat     lat_of_ecef  probe.g_x  probe.g_y  probe.g_z
derive  probe.g_rlon     lon_of_ecef  probe.g_x  probe.g_y  probe.g_z
derive  probe.g_rhae     hae_of_ecef  probe.g_x  probe.g_y  probe.g_z
derive  probe.e_lat      lat_of_ecef  probe.e_x  probe.e_y  probe.e_z
derive  probe.e_lon      lon_of_ecef  probe.e_x  probe.e_y  probe.e_z
derive  probe.e_hae      hae_of_ecef  probe.e_x  probe.e_y  probe.e_z
# Keys and `derive` lines of the derive functions added in engine-spec 0.18:
# `tokens`, `has_token` and `text_if`. Every argument here is a key no other
# probe pack maps, so these lines set nothing in the vectors of earlier
# versions. The first four lines go both ways: flags from fl_a, fl_b and
# fl_c, and each flag from flags (ruling 8: an absent flag becomes 0).
key  fl_a     int     -  "a flag: token alpha of flags"
key  fl_b     int     -  "a flag: token beta of flags"
key  fl_c     int     -  "a flag: token gamma of flags"
key  flags    string  -  "derived: tokens alpha, beta, gamma of fl_a, fl_b, fl_c, joined by a comma"
key  fl_p     int     -  "a flag: token p of ptok"
key  fl_src   int     -  "an input integer: fl_late is not of it"
key  fl_late  int     -  "derived: not fl_src, by a line after the one that reads it (ruling 7)"
key  ptok     string  -  "derived: tokens p, q of fl_p and fl_late, joined by /"
key  sp1      int     -  "a flag: token x of spt and a of ut"
key  sp2      int     -  "a flag: token y of spt and b of ut"
key  spt      string  -  "derived: tokens x, y of sp1, sp2, joined by the separator named space"
key  ut       string  -  "derived: tokens a, b of sp1, sp2, joined by U+00E9 (one code point)"
key  w1       string  -  "an input text"
key  w2       string  -  "an input text"
key  wj       string  -  "derived: join:space of w1 and w2, joined by the text space (ruling 9)"
key  wtxt     string  -  "an input text of tokens"
key  wsp      int     -  "derived: 1 when b is a part of wtxt split at U+0020"
key  wcol     int     -  "derived: 1 when b is a part of wtxt split at a colon"
key  tif_in   int     -  "an input integer"
key  tif      string  -  "derived: the text a:b when tif_in is not 0"
derive  probe.flags    tokens:comma:alpha,beta,gamma  probe.fl_a  probe.fl_b  probe.fl_c
derive  probe.fl_a     has_token:comma:alpha  probe.flags
derive  probe.fl_b     has_token:comma:beta   probe.flags
derive  probe.fl_c     has_token:comma:gamma  probe.flags
derive  probe.ptok     tokens:/:p,q           probe.fl_p  probe.fl_late
derive  probe.fl_late  not                    probe.fl_src
derive  probe.spt      tokens:space:x,y       probe.sp1  probe.sp2
derive  probe.ut       tokens:é:a,b           probe.sp1  probe.sp2
derive  probe.wj       join:space             probe.w1  probe.w2
derive  probe.wsp      has_token:space:b      probe.wtxt
derive  probe.wcol     has_token:colon:b      probe.wtxt
derive  probe.tif      text_if:a:b            probe.tif_in
# Keys of the kind-selection probe packs (engine-spec 0.20): integers that
# only one `case` of a `switch` maps. No `derive` line reads or sets them.
key  v1  int  -  "an integer mapped inside one case of a switch (spec 0.20)"
key  v2  int  -  "an integer mapped inside one case of a switch (spec 0.20)"
key  v3  int  -  "an integer mapped inside one case of a switch (spec 0.20)"
key  v4  int  -  "an integer mapped inside one case of a switch (spec 0.20)"
# Keys and `derive` lines of the derive functions added in engine-spec 0.31:
# `ns_of`, `sec_of_ns` and `nsec_of_ns` (`ns_of_ms` and `ms_of_ns` are the two
# lines of core). Every argument here is a key no other probe pack maps.
key  ns_sec   int  s   "an input count of seconds (spec 0.31)"
key  ns_nsec  int  ns  "an input count of nanoseconds, any value (spec 0.31)"
key  ns_sum   int  ns  "derived: ns_of(ns_sec, ns_nsec)"
key  ns_in    int  ns  "an input instant in epoch nanoseconds (spec 0.31)"
key  ns_s     int  s   "derived: sec_of_ns(ns_in)"
key  ns_n     int  ns  "derived: nsec_of_ns(ns_in)"
derive  probe.ns_sum  ns_of       probe.ns_sec  probe.ns_nsec
derive  probe.ns_s    sec_of_ns   probe.ns_in
derive  probe.ns_n    nsec_of_ns  probe.ns_in
# Keys of the probe packs of offset positions (engine-spec 0.35): references,
# raw offsets and a nested vertex latitude. No `derive` line reads or sets them.
key  ref_lat  float  deg  "a reference latitude (spec 0.35)"
key  ref_lon  float  deg  "a reference longitude (spec 0.35)"
key  dlat     float  deg  "a raw latitude offset (spec 0.35, ruling 6)"
key  raw      int    -    "a raw integer at the place of an offset (spec 0.35)"
key  t0       int    ms   "a reference time, epoch milliseconds (spec 0.35)"
key  toff     int    ms   "a raw time offset in milliseconds (spec 0.35, ruling 6)"
key  v_lat    float  deg  "a latitude of a nested item (spec 0.35)"
# Keys of the probe packs of products of fields (engine-spec 0.36): factors,
# values scaled by them, and a raw scale code. No `derive` line reads or sets them.
key  fac    float  -  "a factor (spec 0.36)"
key  ifac   int    -  "an integer factor (spec 0.36)"
key  fv     float  -  "a value times or per a factor (spec 0.36)"
key  fw     float  -  "a second value times or per a factor (spec 0.36)"
key  scode  int    -  "a raw scale code (spec 0.36)"
# Keys of the probe packs of the byte order chosen per message (engine-spec
# 0.37): an order flag and a byte-order mark. No `derive` line reads or sets them.
key  oflag  int  -  "an order flag (spec 0.37)"
key  bom    int  -  "a byte-order mark read as an integer (spec 0.37)"
pack:
format probe
version 0.42.0
distribution public
source "probe"
uses probe
wire bits
word_bytes 1
field probe.x 0:0:8 uint
kind k
  when 0:0:8 1
charset D 0123456789
